title: USGS 3DEP bare-earth terrain · 20 April 2023
attribution: U.S. Geological Survey / NV5 Geospatial. Public-domain 3DEP data; NOAA metadata.
notes: CA_SanFrancisco_B23 lidar, acquired 2023-04-20. Native project DEM 0.25 m; this world uses the standardized USGS 1 m DEM, sampled onto 5 m nodes. Absolute NAVD88 (GEOID18) metres. Source project accuracy tests are not local accuracy claims for this sampled grid. Native subset, metadata and extraction script are retained under public/reference. Ground beneath buildings is interpolated.
